tasks.contract: Compare reviewers on frozen code and task data. Exclude malformed/unavailable routes before helper calls. Bind helper and prompt-budget provenance to the frozen helper bytes. Redact route identity without corrupting findings. Forward only the explicit OS allowlist and declared credentials; prove ambient environment isolation. Keep failed/interrupted samples in the denominator.

tasks.head: 28bf3c25bcba2f04bf29a518238cb4a8588dcc5e
tasks.contract: Dispatch and accept use immutable snapshots and pinned scope/approval. An issue-only snapshot requires its scope fingerprint. Rebuilding a refused attempt removes stale Project documents. Phase queues validate all durable write identities before exposing any mutation. Amend writes and registers pins before resume; reconcile any possibly-live resume after a crash, never repeat it silently. Snapshot definitions respect Markdown fences and nested-list boundaries.

tasks.head: 02efa6e6e534ddae320f96dcebb7296cb0692df5
tasks.contract: Backup switching must prove previous-attempt writers and collectors are retired before replacement. Inspect previous-attempt collectors independently of caller exemptions. Process evidence must distinguish absent and unavailable. Literal path references include quoted exact paths and descendants, never a longer sibling prefix. Markers belong to the environment, not argv. Do not execute or kill unrelated processes.

cases.trigger: One otherwise valid route plus a rejected provider-less route. blindFinding reads every declared route after the valid route returns.
cases.consequence: The rejected route is excluded by routeCheck, but unguarded blindFinding loses the paid valid result.

cases.trigger: A short route id such as body or anthropic occurs inside finding JSON fields or paths.
cases.consequence: Unbounded substring replacement corrupts finding fields and blind grading.

cases.trigger: A declared route lacks id; schema-error exclusion and persisted admission must still complete.
cases.consequence: Malformed route can fail the whole run rather than remain an excluded admission.

cases.trigger: Set an ambient numeric token setting; the fixture asserts a literal independent of child environment.
cases.consequence: Required isolation proof cannot fail when its guarded behavior breaks.

cases.trigger: The frozen helper uses a different prompt budget than the hardcoded manifest value.
The source repository has a supported local diff setting that changes emitted diff bytes.
cases.consequence: An identical scratch checkout produces different digests and replay rejects every selected case.

cases.trigger: A regression forwards an unrelated environment key into the helper.
cases.consequence: No fixture exercises the required child allowlist; the readiness proof is missing.

cases.trigger: An issue-only snapshot omits scope fingerprint while other seam fields exist.
cases.consequence: Worker receives a fabricated project-first fallback rather than the required approval identity.

cases.trigger: Crash after successful resume, before acceptAmend returns; caller retries the identical amendment.
cases.consequence: Pins are already registered before resume in this head; the claimed opposite ordering does not exist. Live-process refusal requires reconciliation already mandated by the contract.

cases.trigger: A nested definition is followed by a list item outdented to the parent list.
cases.consequence: The parser absorbs a sibling into the prior definition, violating snapshot selection boundaries.

cases.trigger: A previous-attempt collector appears among descendants of this invocation.
cases.consequence: Caller exemption skips the collector before ownership checks, allowing overlapping collectors.

cases.trigger: Reference /tmp/worktree; command reads a quoted longer sibling /tmp/worktree copy/check.mjs.
cases.consequence: Quote-insensitive delimiter logic treats the sibling as this task and falsely blocks an ordinary switch.

cases.trigger: A real receipt stores digest(canonical helper string), while bench hashes raw bytes.
cases.consequence: Every real helper is excluded; the main operation cannot replay receipts.

cases.trigger: A refused full dispatch is rebuilt as short under the same attempt.
cases.consequence: Old PRD/Spec files survive and contaminate the worker snapshot.

cases.trigger: A new missing write precedes an already-applied id reused with changed payload.
cases.consequence: The confirmation stub stops at first missing write; accept prints the conflicting later write before checking every identity.

cases.trigger: A process command argument contains the expected MONO_ATTEMPT marker, but its environment does not.
cases.consequence: Combined ps argv/environment parsing falsely attributes the unrelated process.
